$comment: Source schema for the OWASP Threat Model Library CycloneDX 2.0 profile. The CycloneDX models it references come from the specification fork pinned in build-schema.sh; run that script to regenerate the bundled schema. Do not edit the bundled file by hand.
title: OWASP Threat Model Library CycloneDX 2.0 Schema
description: A CycloneDX 2.0 profile for OWASP Threat Model Library documents. It is CycloneDX 2.0 plus rules that require every element threat-model.schema.json requires, so any valid document converts back to the library format without loss. See cyclonedx/README.md and scripts/cyclonedx_convert.py.

specFormat.title: Specification Format
specFormat.description: Specifies the format. This value shall be CycloneDX.

specVersion.title: Specification Version
specVersion.description: The version of the CycloneDX specification the threat model conforms to.

serialNumber.title: BOM Serial Number
serialNumber.description: Unique identifier for this threat-model BOM.

version.title: BOM Version
version.description: Revision number for this threat-model BOM.

metadata.description: Threat-model metadata. At least one tool component is required.

threats.description: Threats, one scenario per threat (holding its persona and event), and the CAPEC attack patterns they use.

blueprints.description: Exactly one blueprint, holding the threat model's architecture and data flows.

scope.description: Scope of the threat model. Its classification has no CycloneDX field yet, so it is held in properties.

asset.description: A part of the system. Either an inline asset of any CycloneDX asset type (component, agent, model, tool, data, ...) with a name and description, or a reference to a BOM component such as an ML model with its model card. Every asset names its trust zone.

relationship.description: A typed relationship between modelled elements. Any predefined CycloneDX kind is allowed. The only custom kinds are a control's mitigates and supports links to threats.

custom.description: A control's links to the threats it addresses: mitigates for direct mitigations (Tier 1 in LF AI's mappings) and, optionally, supports for supporting controls (Tier 2). Each type at most once.

flow.description: A flow of any CycloneDX type. Data flows are the library's data flows and must say whether they are encrypted.

visualization.description: A diagram with its source embedded. Diagrams kept elsewhere, such as on Mural, must be exported and embedded; a url may sit alongside. PNG content is base64-encoded.

blueprint.description: The single blueprint holding the threat model's architecture. Everything the OWASP Threat Model Library requires is required here.

threatProfile.description: A threat persona. Whether it is a person, its access level and its malicious intent are required; skill level and applicability to the organisation are optional.

affectedAssets.description: The modelled elements the threat affects: assets of any type, flows, data stores, data sets or zones.

threat.description: A threat. Its persona and triggering event live on the matching scenario.

attackPattern.description: An attack pattern from CAPEC (ap-capec-<id>, with a capecId), MITRE ATLAS (ap-atlas-<id>) or MITRE ATT&CK (ap-attack-<id>). ATLAS and ATT&CK patterns describe their technique in techniques, each with an id or a tactic; the exact MITRE ID, such as AML.T0051.001, goes in techniques[].id.

appliesTo.description: The modelled elements the control protects: assets, zones, flows, data stores, data sets or trust boundaries. Without it, the control applies to the whole system.

attackPath.description: An attack path. Each step's source and destination are references to modelled elements; a place that is not modelled goes in the step's description instead.
